text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby had finally 
arrived. Receiving encouragement from her 
mother, Eishin Flash headed out, trying to 
keep to her usual routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She felt a tremor. Awakened amidst the 
overwhelming excitement was an absolute 
will for "victory"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—I will be the one to become a Derby 
Umamusume. Carrying that resolute 
determination, she steps up to the 
once-in-a-lifetime showdown.
